OVERVIEW: A Swift command-line tool.

USAGE: swifty <subcommand>

OPTIONS:
  --log-level <log-level> Logging level (values: trace, debug, info)
  -h, --help              Show help information.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  compile                 Compile sources.
  test                    Run tests.

  See 'swifty help <subcommand>' for detailed help.
